Abstract
Traditionalmathematics,logicandphilosophicalsystemshavelongexistedindisciplinary
fragmentation:theymerelylabelcontradictoryequationsandclassicallogicalparadoxesas
“unsolvable,”“contradictory”or“tobeavoided”atasuperficiallevel,failingtointerpret
theontologicaloriginsofparadoxesandtheconnotationsofunderlyingcosmicrules.
Meanwhile,nounifiedframeworkhasbeenestablishedtounpackthefundamentallogicof
humanliteraryandartisticcreation.RelyingontheBSDTernaryOriginAxiom,theDual-Zero
OntologicalSubstrateandtheFive-ValuedTruthSpectrumSystem,thispapertakesthe
fundamentalcontradictoryequation asanentrypointtorealizeanoverallcognitive
dimensionalupgrade.Itbreaksthroughthelimitationoftraditionalmathematics,whichonly
judgesnumericalcontradictions,andreconstructscontradictoryequationsfromanexistential
perspective.Itthendisassemblestheunifiedmechanismsandlocatestruthvaluesforcore
classicalparadoxesofhumanity,includingtheLiarParadox,Russell’sBarberParadox,Zeno’s
DichotomyParadoxandSchrödinger’sCat,extractingtheultimateuniversaltheoremthatthe
essenceofallparadoxesliesinmismatchedboundaryrules.Further,itdismantlesdisciplinary
barriersbetweennaturalsciencesandhumanitiesandarts.Derivingthreerealmsofliterary
systems―physicalsci-fi,mathematicalnumber-fantasyandphilosophicalmetaphysicalfantasy
―fromthethreeaxiomsofindividuality,mutabilityandrelationality,thepapersystematically
categorizesallformsofartsuchasfilm,televisionandgames,andinterpretstheiraesthetic
mechanisms.x−1=x
WhyThisPaperEngagesinDialoguewithTraditionalChineseClassics
ThispaperdemonstratesthattheBSDTernaryAxiomsarenotan“invention”ofnewlaws,but
a“discovery”andmathematicformalizationofuniversalcosmicprinciplesarticulatedin
differentlinguisticexpressionsbyancientChineseandWesternthinkers.
ThispaperultimatelyprovesthattheBSDMeta-MathematicalSystemachievesagrand
unificationspanningfundamentalmathematicalcontradictions,classicallogicalparadoxes,
spatial-temporalboundarydemarcation,humanliterarycreationandcognitiveaestheticlaws.It

completesafundamentalparadigmshiftfrommechanicalconstitutivismtoorganic
generativism,constructingacompletemeta-theoreticalframeworkcompatiblewithboth
naturalsciencesandhumanisticsystems.
Keywords:BSDMeta-Mathematics;TernaryAxioms;Dual-ZeroOntology;Five-ValuedTruth;
BoundaryDivision;ParadoxResolution;GrandUnificationofLiteratureandArt;Ontology
Introduction
Theentiretrajectoryofhumancognitivedevelopmentishauntedbytwocoreperplexities:first,
logicalperplexity.Humanthoughtautonomouslyconstructscontradictoryequations,self-
referentialparadoxes,temporal-spatialparadoxesandotherundecidablepropositions.
Traditionaldisciplinescanonlypassivelyevadeorqualitativelylabelthemunsolvable,without
answeringthefundamentalquestionofwhyparadoxesnecessarilyexist.Second,cognitive
mappingperplexity.Therehaslongbeenalackofauniversalmappingsystemlinkingthe
underlyingmathematicalandtemporal-spatialevolutionaryrulesoftheobjectiveworldto
humanlinguisticexpression,literarycreationandaestheticcognition,leavingnaturalsciences
andhumanitiesandartsfragmentedandisolatedfromoneanother.
Gödel’sIncompletenessTheoremsrevealtheinherentflawsofunidimensionalbinaryformal
systems,provingthatclosedsystemsinevitablycontainundecidablepropositions,yettheyfail
toexplaintheontologicalvalueandboundaryoriginsofundecidablestatements.
Fundamentally,thisstemsfromthesystemiclimitationsofWesternmonolithicformallogic.
Interpretationsofvariousparadoxesintraditionalmathematics,logicandphysicsremain
scatteredandfragmented,lackingaunifiedstandardofjudgment.Literarytheoryhasalways
remainedatthelevelofempiricalsummary,unabletotracethemeta-axiomsunderlyingartistic
creation.
Bycontrast,traditionalChineseclassicalthoughtalreadyencapsulatesacompletecognitive
systemofhierarchicalboundaries,discriminationbetweenemptinessandexistence,substance
andfunction,andthebalanceofyinandyang:
•
TaoTeChing:“Existenceandnon-existencegenerateoneanother;highandlowincline
towardoneanother”presupposesthemechanismofdialecticalunitybetweenvirtualand
realboundaries.
•
TheBookofChanges:“ThatwhichismetaphysicaliscalledtheDao;thatwhichisphysicalis
calledthevessel”establisheshierarchicalontologicaldivision.
•
Zhuangzi:“Mylifehasalimit,yetknowledgeisboundless”impliesboundarycognitionfor
finitesystems.
•
TheDoctrineoftheMean:“Attainingcentralharmony,heavenandearthsettleintheir
positions,andallthingsflourish”correspondstothesteadystateofbalanceacrossthree
dimensions.

Thismodelclearlyillustratesthehierarchicaldivisionandboundarylogicofthefivetruth
values:TrueStatements,Positive/InverseStatementsandFallaciousStatementscanallbe
coveredorasymptoticallyinterpretedbytraditionalbinarylogic.OnlySuspendedStatements
occupythecoreboundaryquadrantof“unprovableandunfalsifiable.”Thismathematical
divisionrigorouslyprovesthatlinguisticbarriers,semanticparadoxesandcognitiveblindspots
withintraditionalmathematicalsystemsareneitherfailuresofhumancognitivecapacitynor
logicalloopholesofsystems,butinevitableboundarysteady-statestructuresofclosedformal
systemsconfinedtoasinglelayer―fullyremedyingtheunderlyingsemanticdefectsand
mathematicalblindspotsofbinarylogic.
Contrarytotheconventionalmisconceptionthatundecidablepropositionsamountto
“cognitiveblanks,systemdefects,unresolvedloopholes,”theBSDsystemdefinitively
establishes:SuspendedStatementspossessanindependentontologicalstatusasafifth
primitivesteady-statetype,distinctfromderivativeorsecondarypropositionsorstatesof
incompletecognition.Theircoreontologicalfeaturesandmathematicalattributesareas
follows:
•
Dualboundaryattribute(originoflinguisticbarriers):Strictlysatisfyingthedualboundary
constraintsofunprovabilityandunfalsifiability,theyconstitutenaturalbarriersformedby
thecouplingofformallanguage,logicalrulesandsystemboundaries,providingthesole
precisemathematicaldefinitionforlong-standinglinguisticboundaryproblemsin
mathematics.
•
Information-isolatedsteadystate:SuspendedStatementsformanexclusiveinformation-
isolatedstatewithinformalsystems,uninvolvedininternalsystementropyincreaseor
decrease,freeofstructuraldissipationorsteady-statedrift,andperpetuallymaintaining
neutralself-sustainingboundaryequilibrium―thisistheiruniquedefiningfeatureseparating
themfromtheotherfourtruthvalues.
•
Independentontologicalvalue:Notderivativeorsecondarysubordinatepropositions,they
formanindispensablecoredimensionwithinthefive-valuedtruthspectrum,anecessary
foundationforcompleteformalsystemstorealizeself-referentialdescription,boundary
definition,hierarchicaldimensionalupgradeanduniversalclosure.
•
Cognitiveinevitability:Aninherentcomponentofhumancognitivesystemsandformal
logicalframeworks.Alllinguisticbarriers,semanticboundaries,self-referentialparadoxes,
layeredcognitivelimitationsandundecidablepropositionsarefundamentallyexternal
manifestationsofSuspendedStatementsindifferentcontexts.

domaindivisionwithintheBSDsystem.TrueandPositiveStatementsconstitutereal
